newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KLINSMANN SCORES TWICE AS BAYERN BEAT CELTIC.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN SCORES TWICE AS BAYERN BEAT CELTIC.

text.p: Two goals from German international skipper Juergen Klinsmann gave Bayern Munich a 2-1 win over Celtic in a friendly at Parkhead on Wednesday.

Bayern, who on Tuesday lost 1-0 to Raith Rovers, the bottom club in Scotland's premier division, went ahead through Klinsmann after 27 minutes and increased their lead with a second goal from the former Tottenham striker after 66 minutes.
Malky Mackay halved Bayern's lead when he scored with a header two minutes later.

A crowd of just over 40,000 saw the match between the two former European champions, which was staged as a testimonial for Celtic's long-serving midfielder Peter Grant who earned about 350,000 pounds ($578,000) from the night.
